items: *A – Could* you play the guitar when you were a child?
*A –* Where did you learn how to play it?
*A – Could* you play the trumpet when you were a child?
*B –* Yes, I *could* play it when I was a child. What musical instrument can you play?
*A –* In fact, I am *not able* to play any instrument.
*B –* I must practice with the trumpet this weekend because I’ll have a concert very soon.
*A –* A concert? How interesting! My sister Melissa *could* play the piano when she was only fourteen years old, but she never got an opportunity to have her own concert.
*A – Would* you like to learn how to play the violin?
*A –* Maybe my father or my mother *could* teach you.
*B –* Good idea! *Could* they play the violin when they were younger?
*A –* No, they *couldn’t*. They learned how to play it just two years ago.
